title: Schema scopes and activation-scoped facts
preamble:
# Schema scopes and activation-scoped facts

Schema-level fact lifecycle declarations, under a single `scope`
keyword on the schema. `scope activation` is a lifetime category and
`scope ambient` is a permissions boundary.

Paired with:
- [LFAC] — base schema syntax that
  `scope` extends.
- [LLOG] — `scope logical`
  semantics live there.
- [LCCO] — capture facts
  ([LCCO.5]) are engine-internal uses of the same activation-
  scoped primitive defined here.
- [LRST] — `as <expr>` on `after` for
  per-fact supersedure.
- [LGRA] — the `scope` keyword grammar
  production.
- [LADP] — adapter-
  published schemas adopt `scope ambient`.

## What this is not

- Not a runtime-implementation guide. Engine bookkeeping for
  activation-scoped facts (completion-path enumeration,
  capture-fact reuse) lives with runtime docs.
- Not a queue / serialisation surface. `scope activation` does
  not buffer suppressed activations. Authors who need durable
  work survival use the WorkItem decoupling pattern.
